description: Land Acquisition - Dayagama West, Nuwara eliya D/S Division, Nuwara eliya District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1916/04 of 25.05.2015, Badulla D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific parcels of land for public purposes, including descriptions of land lots, extents, locations, current land use, and claimant information. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
